purpose: Teach: 焼きそば/シチュー/ヘルシー/試飲/薄め/ふき/アサヒ/お中元

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、文化祭で、本気で、絶対、焼きそば、絶対、出すよね
lines.en: Riku, you're definitely doing yakisoba at the festival, right? Like, for real.
lines.style: Quick, urgent, testing—like she's holding him to a promise. Bright energy but with an edge underneath. Bounces slightly forward on 'definitely.'

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うん。給食の、本気で、絶対、シチュー、絶対、美味かったぜ、桜
lines.en: Yeah. That cafeteria stew was genuinely incredible, Sakura.
lines.style: Warm, a little defensive of his own opinion. Easy smile in the voice. Settles back, relaxed. The 'genuinely' lands with quiet conviction.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: お母さん、本気で、絶対、ヘルシー、絶対、お弁当、絶対、作ってくれてるよ、リク
lines.en: Your mom makes those bentos so carefully, you know? Like, really healthy ones for you.
lines.style: Softer than before. Noticing something about him she doesn't say out loud. Slight warmth in 'carefully.' Trailing off like she's said enough.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 店頭で、本気で、絶対、試飲、絶対、できるって、看板、絶対、あったぜ、桜
lines.en: There was a sign at that store saying you could do a free taste test, right?
lines.style: Animated, almost conspiratorial. Quick tempo. Like he's building a case. Leans in with the detail. Small laugh underneath, like he knows this matters to her.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 家庭科で、本気で、絶対、味付けの、絶対、薄め、絶対、と、絶対、濃いめ、絶対、習ったよね、リク
lines.en: In home ec we learned about seasoning, didn't we? How to make things subtle or rich, depending.
lines.style: Thoughtful, measured. Speaking from actual learning. Slight pause before 'depending'—like she's thinking it through. Genuine interest in the topic, not performing.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お祖母ちゃん、本気で、絶対、お庭の、絶対、ふき、絶対、収穫したって、桜
lines.en: My grandma actually harvested butterbur from the garden the other day.
lines.style: Casual, almost offhand. Like he's sharing something ordinary that's actually kind of cool. Warm mention of his grandmother. Natural rhythm, no performance.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: お父さん、本気で、絶対、アサヒ、絶対、新聞、絶対、読んでるよね、リク
lines.en: Your dad reads the Asahi every morning, doesn't he? Really studies it.
lines.style: Observant, noticing the detail. Quiet respect underneath. Slow tempo on this one—like she's seeing something about his family that matters. Gentle.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃんから、本気で、絶対、お中元、絶対、届いたぜ、桜
lines.en: My grandfather sent me a mid-year gift box last week.
lines.style: Simple statement delivered with real warmth. No irony. Just—sharing something good that happened. Voice softens slightly on 'sent.' Genuine pleasure.
